scenario: Require strongly consistent read for one control key
preconditions: Control store adapter claims the distributed fencing profile
expected_result: Read returns current body and opaque ETag or generation
notes: No cached or stale control record is accepted

scenario: Reject stores without atomic compare-and-swap
preconditions: Provider store exposes only unconditional PUT
expected_result: Initialization refuses strict mode
notes: No fallback to unconditional writes

scenario: Accept strictly newer token activation
preconditions: Coordinator issues token greater than persisted high-water
expected_result: Control record advances high-water and becomes ACTIVE
required_evidence: Coordinator grant and control object generation
notes: Token source must be linearizable and durable

scenario: Reject token equal to or below consumed high-water for a different lease
preconditions: Control object already consumed token T
operation: Activate another lease with T or less
expected_result: Activation rejected without mutation
notes: Never reset or reuse fencing tokens after restore

scenario: Resolve activation CAS timeout by rereading the control object
preconditions: Control CAS may have committed but response is lost
expected_result: Same token and lease are recognized as activated
notes: Do not allocate a new token on blind retry

scenario: Reject old token after a newer epoch is activated
preconditions: Writer A holds T1 while T2 activation CAS succeeds
expected_result: Old writer is rejected and pointer remains at current commit
notes: A stale writer may leave only unreferenced staging objects

scenario: Serialize competing activation CAS operations
preconditions: Two coordinators attempt increasing scope tokens concurrently
expected_result: Only a valid monotonic order is committed
required_evidence: Control-object version history and token sequence
notes: Coordinator allocation is a separate linearizable prerequisite

scenario: Use token-specific immutable payload keys
preconditions: Two leases upload the same logical backup concurrently
expected_result: Distinct staging keys are written; neither is visible until pointer CAS
notes: No unconditional overwrite of shared payload keys

scenario: Publish only by conditional control-object update
preconditions: Payload and manifest digests are verified
expected_result: One control-object CAS exposes the commit
required_evidence: Control object before/after and manifest digest
notes: Payload upload alone is not a backup commit

scenario: Resolve lost conditional-write response through recent receipt
preconditions: Commit CAS may succeed and network response is dropped
operation: Retry the same operation sequence and idempotency key
expected_result: Same receipt is returned without another commit
required_evidence: Control object receipt and version history
notes: Strongly consistent read is required

scenario: Reject same sequence or key with different manifest digest
preconditions: Receipt already exists for the operation
expected_result: Conflict is returned and pointer is unchanged
notes: No last-writer-wins behavior

scenario: Reject an older operation sequence after a newer sequence commits
preconditions: Sequence 12 has committed
expected_result: Old sequence is rejected or reported unknown
notes: Coordinator must allocate sequence monotonically

scenario: Return OUTCOME_UNKNOWN outside the receipt window
preconditions: Old operation sequence is below high-water but its receipt was evicted
expected_result: No blind replay occurs
notes: Retention horizon is an explicit deployment policy

scenario: Serialize publish and revoke on the same control object
preconditions: Publisher and releaser race on one ETag/generation
operation: Publish CAS races with revoke CAS
expected_result: Exactly one CAS order is observed; writes after revoke are rejected
required_evidence: Ordered CAS generations and final state
notes: CAS success is the revocation linearization point

scenario: Resolve revocation timeout by rereading state
preconditions: Revoke CAS may have committed
expected_result: REVOKED state is confirmed or result remains unknown
notes: Never report release success before store CAS confirmation

scenario: Reject proof for another fencing scope
preconditions: Valid proof is signed for a different scope
expected_result: No control record changes
notes: Scope and control key must be identical

scenario: Reject lease or proof tenant mismatch
preconditions: Control object is bound to tenant A
expected_result: Mutation is rejected
notes: No cross-tenant scope reuse

scenario: Reject expired proof or expired active lease
preconditions: Proof or persisted lease expiry is in the past
expected_result: Provider refuses publication
notes: Clock skew and time source must be controlled

scenario: Prevent clients from writing the control object directly
preconditions: Client has staging upload permission only
operation: Attempt unconditional or conditional write to control key
expected_result: Authorization denies direct write
notes: Gateway must be sole control-object writer

scenario: Verify selected object store conditions cover the final control operation
preconditions: Concrete S3/GCS/Azure account and API configuration exist
expected_result: Only supported operations are declared fenced
notes: Generic CAS model does not certify a cloud SDK
